findings.reason: without a control that can return a non-zero spread, §14's "not separated" verdict is unreachable and an arm with no effect is reported as adopted.
findings.text: §14's negative control reports "the largest absolute paired difference" over 126 half-splits of the clive arm, but each split is a disjoint partition of ten section-level pairs, so no section appears in both halves and no paired difference exists between them; taken instead as the clive arm's paired difference against its baseline (clive), it is identically zero, so the reported spread is always zero and every arm difference, however small, reads as separated — the control cannot report "not separated" and so does not measure what it claims

findings.reason: a second control that removes the reflex's skip and requires a review to appear is what distinguishes an absent guard from an unreached one, and without it §13's first of four findings measures nothing.
findings.text: §13's done-when asserts "The review reflex composes no review for it" but its only negative control removes the lander's measurement skip, so nothing shows the review-reflex guard fires; if the fixture run never becomes review-eligible, the assertion passes on unfixed code

findings.reason: a reuse map belongs in the node brief composed from this review, and a plan-fixed mechanism is a guess the reviewer would have to test against the code; the endpoint (dispatch flag, two skips, one ledger outcome) is what the plan may fix.
findings.text: §13's Deliverable prescribes the implementation: it names the modules to extend and the exact function (`dispatch_review_for_run`) whose eligibility must change, and fixes the reuse map (dispatch option parsing, review reflex eligibility, lander candidate selection) in plan text

findings.reason: an unresolvable population leaves the record's ten sections chosen by whatever the worker guesses, which is exactly the section-difficulty confound the section exists to remove.
findings.text: §14 defines the population as "ten sections that this session's runs landed, from plans this session owns", but "this session" names no durable set: a dispatcher in a later session, or a resumed node, cannot resolve which sections qualify, so the population — and therefore the paired comparison and its seed — is not obtainable from the system the section describes

response_events.note: §14's negative control is now a replicate clive run per section (ten more runs, sixty in all): the clive-vs-clive-replicate paired difference with its paired bootstrap 90% interval is the same-arm spread, and an arm whose paired-difference interval overlaps it is reported not separated, so the control can return a non-zero spread.

§13's done-when adds a second negative control: with the review reflex's measurement skip removed, the first case finds a review composed for the fixture run, so the reflex assertion cannot pass on a run that was never review-eligible.

§13's Deliverable now states only the endpoint (the dispatch flag, the reflex and lander skips, the measured ledger outcome, no second ledger); the module and function reuse map moves to the node brief. Write paths still name the modules for scope.
